item.title: At a loss as to which Stephen Moss you’re referring to? So are many others | Letters
item.summary: Stephen Moss and Stephen Moss find the humour in having the same name and working for the same company At least the Guardian’s Ewan Murray and Sky Sports’ Ewen Murray work for different outlets ( A tale of two Murrays: when Ewan met Ewen to talk Tiger Woods, stiff gins and 15 years of mistaken identity, 8 August ). Stephen Moss (former literary editor, and chess and classical music expert) and I ( Birdwatch columnist ) both write for the Guardian, causing endless confusion. A member of Sedgemoor chess club once told me that “We would be very honoured if you could come and give us a game” (they wouldn’t), while a woman, after admitting that she “quite enjoyed” my birding articles, spoiled it by adding “but when you write about classical music, it’s absolutely wonderful!” Continue reading...
